pages: As a new day dawns on the awakening Palace, a happy, colourful fly and a beautiful butterfly, flutter near the chimes. The Little Chimes smile and reach out to greet Nosey the fly. Other chimes begin to stir and yawn as the butterfly settles on a chime plate.

Master Chi Lu is sweeping the floor. He helps his happy workers prepare for the beautiful day ahead.
Four of the chimes are swinging with big smiles on their faces. Funny FAH and Litfle RAY are holding
Paddle Ball Racquets. Can you see Little RAY? He's the LIGHT BLUE chime. Today he has a band around his forehead like a famous tennis player.

Soon the chimes begin tinkling against their chime plate. A lovely tune drifts on the breeze. But this time one chime unexpectedly stops! It's Little TEE.
Nosey the Fly has landed on her nose! Have you ever tried to blow a fly off your nose?

The sounds of the Little Chimes playing again brought
Master Chi Lu tip-toeing into the room. His curious visitors peered into the Palace foyer.
The old master now can see the chimes have settled their differences. He warmly invites the visitors to move closer to listen to their gentle tunes.
